_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every company fact used anywhere on the site. A number is defined once here and never diverges between pages. Every '[[TODO: ...]]' value must be replaced with a verified figure from internal sources before launch — an empty marker is correct, an invented number is a failure. '_comment' keys describe what to supply and in what unit; they are ignored by the templates. Values marked 'from brief' came from the project brief and should still be confirmed.

machines._comment: The machine park — primary credibility asset, shown on /equipment. Data extracted 2026-08 from the company's previous website (last updated ~2020): real, previously published figures, NOT invented. Machines may have been added or retired since, so every entry carries needsConfirmation:true until production confirms it — the build prints a warning listing them. 'chain' is metal|wood; items are listed in PROCESS ORDER within each chain and the page renders them in this order. 'category' is the process stage slug (labels in equipment.json stageLabels). 'highlight' machines lead the page with a large card. Descriptions are page copy and live in src/content/en/equipment.json keyed by 'id'. Where a value was not on the old site it is a [[TODO]] — do not infer.
